title: Node added to SceneInstance via Editable Children sets Owner to be Root instead of SceneInstance.
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4790 CPU @ 3.60GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

Accessing the `owner` property from a script attached to a Node (e.g.: "MovementComponent" node) that is part of the original Scene (e.g.: "Entity" scene) returns the root Node of that SceneInstance (e.g.: "Entity" node), while accessing the `owner` property from a script attached to a Node (e.g.: "InputComponent") that was added to the original Scene (e.g.: "Entity") via the "Editable Children" option returns the root Node of the Scene the SceneInstance is a part of (e.g.: "World").

I'd expect sibling Nodes to have the same `owner`.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project.
2. Create a new Scene ("A").
3. Create another new Scene ("B").
4. Add instance of one Scene ("A") to the other Scene ("B").
5. Create Script ("C") that prints `owner` when the `ready` method is called.
6. Add Node ("Node") with Script to Scene used as instance ("A").
7. Add Node ("Node2") with Script to instance of Scene used as instance ("A") via "Editable Children".
8. Observe discrepant output.
9. Be discombobulated.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[new-game-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19675002/new-game-project.zip)
